facts.fact: Ivoirexpress reports SNDI says it built the information system of the CEPICI one-stop shop, which allows companies to be created in 24 hours.
Ivoirexpress reports a capacity-building seminar for civil servants and state agents of the Hambol region opened on 22 June 2026, at which SNDI presented the state's digital applications.
SNDI's deputy director general says all actors of the Katiola budget execution system, including the prefecture, use a satellite network to execute and monitor their budget.

CIV.note: SIGFIP is stated as used for the state budget from 1999 to 2019; its successor is not named.

facts.fact: Ivoirexpress reports SNDI, a state company, develops and deploys business applications for the Ivorian government and operates a national satellite network used by government bodies.
Ivoirexpress reports SNDI developed version 1 of SIGOMAP, which recently replaced SIGMAP for public procurement by ministries.

Ivoirexpress reports SNDI built SIGFIP, SIGMAP and SIGOMAP, the CEPICI one-stop shop system, the building-permit one-stop system, and the government roadmap and decision tracking platforms, naming no contractor.
